scope.note: Only konzultace.html was rebuilt in this world (git branch bauhaus-konzultace). The other pages still carry the older green/gold identity preserved on main. konzultace.html is an intentionally standalone noindex ad landing page.

acceptedExceptions.reason: Single-alphabet typography is native to the Bauhaus foundation world. Hierarchy is carried by Jost's weight range (400/500/600/700 in the shipped build) and the clamp-based type scale. Do not resolve this by adding a second family.

grid.note: Structure Blue at 7% alpha, drawn as a 1px line every 32px on the page background.

display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Lowercase, balanced wrap, with a single non-italic <em> in Signal Red.

title.purpose: Quiz question. Sentence case — it is a spoken question, not a label.

subhead.purpose: Step headings and the signature name block. Explicit text-transform:none.

lead.purpose: Hero sub (max 34ch) and the pain closer, in Second Ink.

body.purpose: Default page text. Bold is 600; 700 is reserved for the promise block and phone links.

label.purpose: Eyebrow, quiz step counter, pending-data key. Uppercase, wide-tracked, Structure Blue.

figure.purpose: Fact-list terms. Tabular numerals so verifiable numbers align.

_unused.purpose: Loaded by the font request but used nowhere in the shipped CSS. Not canonized as a role.

shadows.name: focus-stroke
shadows.purpose: Input focus, paired with a blue border. Drawn inward — not a lift.

shadows.name: error-stroke
shadows.purpose: Invalid field, paired with a red border.

shadows.name: selection-stroke
shadows.purpose: Selected chip; doubles border weight without moving layout.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Border, background and marker-radius transitions on buttons, options and chips.

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: Quiz panel slides 28px in from the right. Straight line, no fade-and-float.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Container 600px → 900px; hero becomes 1fr 300px; quiz column caps at 660px; CTA caps at 420px.

grid.name: module
grid.purpose: Every spacing value is calc(var(--u) * n).

grid.name: baseline
grid.purpose: Visible 1px horizontal rule repeated on the page background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The action itself: a red field led by a white circle. Used for both CTAs and the form submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:11px; width:100%; min-height:64px; background:var(--red,#d8261b); color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:0; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.09rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s ease-out, transform .1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content:""; width:15px; height:15px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; flex:none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--red-deep,#b81d13); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1a3fd0); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background:var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); cursor:default; }

components.name: Text Back Button
components.description: The quiz's step-back control: underlined ink, no chrome, with a padded hit area pulled back by negative margins.
components.css: .ds-btn-back { background:none; border:0; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; color:var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); cursor:pointer; padding:10px 8px; margin:-10px -8px; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-back:hover { color:var(--ink,#141618); } .ds-btn-back:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1a3fd0); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Option Row
components.description: Signature component. An outlined blue square marker that fills red and rounds to a circle on selection — structure becoming action.
components.css: .ds-opts { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; } .ds-opt { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; width:100%; min-height:62px; padding:14px 16px; border:1px solid var(--rule,#c9cbcd); border-radius:0; background:#fff; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink,#141618); transition:border-color .16s ease-out, background .16s ease-out; } .ds-opt::before { content:""; width:15px; height:15px; background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--blue,#1a3fd0); flex:none; transition:background .16s ease-out, border-radius .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out; } .ds-opt:hover { border-color:var(--ink,#141618); } .ds-opt.sel { border-color:var(--red,#d8261b); } .ds-opt.sel::before { background:var(--red,#d8261b); border-color:var(--red,#d8261b); border-radius:50%; } .ds-opt .t { flex:1; } .ds-opt .t small { display:block; font-size:.87rem; color:var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); margin-top:2px; line-height:1.3; } .ds-opt:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1a3fd0); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Two-column square selectors for call-time preference. Selection is a red ring, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:10px; } .ds-chip { min-height:52px; border:1px solid var(--rule,#c9cbcd); border-radius:0; background:#fff; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.99rem; cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); padding:10px; transition:border-color .16s ease-out, color .16s ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--ink,#141618); } .ds-chip.sel { border-color:var(--red,#d8261b); color:var(--ink,#141618); font-weight:600; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--red,#d8261b); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1a3fd0); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square plane input. Focus is a blue border plus inset blue stroke; error is the same in red with a yellow message block.
components.html: Zkontrolujte prosím číslo (9 číslic).
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom:20px; } .ds-field label { display:block; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.93rem; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:7px; color:var(--ink,#141618); } .ds-field input { width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:14px 16px; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.09rem; border:1px solid var(--rule,#c9cbcd); border-radius:0; background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#141618); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#6c7176; } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--blue,#1a3fd0); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue,#1a3fd0); } .ds-field .err { display:none; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; color:var(--ink,#141618); background:var(--yellow,#f5c400); padding:8px 11px; margin-top:7px; font-weight:500; } .ds-field.bad input { border-color:var(--red,#d8261b); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--red,#d8261b); } .ds-field.bad .err { display:flex; }

components.name: Plane Surface
components.description: The system's refusal of the card: a white plane laid on the worktable with a hairline rule. No radius, no shadow, no hover.
components.html:
Uvnitř banky se produkt nedoporučuje podle toho, co potřebujete vy.

Dostanu provizi od instituce — ne od vás.
components.css: .ds-plane { background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--rule,#c9cbcd); border-radius:0; padding:24px; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); font-size:1.04rem; line-height:1.6; } .ds-plane p + p { margin-top:16px; } .ds-plane strong { color:var(--ink,#141618); font-weight:600; }

components.name: Step List
components.description: Signature component. Numbered blue squares threaded by a hairline rule — structure is blue and square.
components.html:
Zavolám vám do 24 hodin

Osobně já, ne call centrum.

Sejdeme se na 30 minut

V Jemnici, u vás, nebo online.
components.css: .ds-steps { counter-reset:s; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-step { position:relative; padding:0 0 28px 46px; counter-increment:s; } .ds-step::before { content:counter(s); position:absolute; left:0; top:1px; width:30px; height:30px; background:var(--blue,#1a3fd0); color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-step::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:15px; top:34px; bottom:4px; width:1px; background:var(--rule,#c9cbcd); } .ds-step:last-child { padding-bottom:0; } .ds-step:last-child::after { display:none; } .ds-step h3 { font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:600; margin:0 0 3px; text-transform:none; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1.08; color:var(--ink,#141618); } .ds-step p { font-size:.98rem; color:var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); line-height:1.5; margin:0; }

components.name: Warning Block
components.description: Yellow full-bleed block for a commitment or failure the reader must not skim. Ink text on yellow; yellow is never a text color.
components.html: Slib: Když vám nemám co nabídnout, řeknu vám to rovnou — a víc se vám neozvu.
components.css: .ds-warn { background:var(--yellow,#f5c400); color:var(--ink,#141618); border-radius:0; padding:20px; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.02rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-warn strong { font-weight:700; }

components.name: Unbuilt Slot
components.description: Signature component. Content that does not exist yet is drawn as visibly unfinished — hatch, dashed border, yellow triangle — so it can never be mistaken for a finished part.
components.html:
Místo pro reference klientů — s plným jménem, obcí a konkrétním výsledkem.
Čeká na doplnění
components.css: .ds-slot { background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--table,#f0f0ee),var(--table,#f0f0ee) 9px,#e6e5e1 9px,#e6e5e1 18px); border:1px dashed var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); border-radius:0; padding:24px; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#141618); } .ds-slot blockquote { margin:0; font-size:1.04rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-slot .waiting { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:.83rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-2,#4a4f54); margin-top:16px; } .ds-slot .waiting::before { content:""; width:0; height:0; border-left:7px solid transparent; border-right:7px solid transparent; border-bottom:12px solid var(--yellow,#f5c400); flex:none; }

components.name: Sticky Action Bar
components.description: Bottom-pinned red action on a worktable strip with a 1px ink rule. Slides up between hero and quiz; hides on success.
components.css: .ds-sticky { position:relative; padding:10px 16px; background:var(--table,#f0f0ee); border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#141618); transform:translateY(125%); transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-sticky.show { transform:none; } .ds-sticky a { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:56px; background:var(--red,#d8261b); color:#fff; text-decoration:none; font-family:'Jost',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1.05rem; } .ds-sticky a:hover { background:var(--red-deep,#b81d13); } .ds-sticky a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1a3fd0); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Form Marks
components.description: The whole icon vocabulary: blue square = structure, red circle = action, yellow triangle = warning. Drawn in CSS, never as assets.
components.css: .ds-forms { display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:16px; } .ds-form-sq, .ds-form-ci, .ds-form-tr { display:block; flex:none; } .ds-form-sq { width:14px; height:14px; background:var(--blue,#1a3fd0); } .ds-form-ci { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--red,#d8261b); } .ds-form-tr { width:0; height:0; border-left:8px solid transparent; border-right:8px solid transparent; border-bottom:14px solid var(--yellow,#f5c400); }

narrative.overview:
This system governs exactly one surface: konzultace.html, the noindex ad landing page. It is a deliberate standalone world. index.html, admin.html, blog.html and gdpr.html still carry the older green/gold identity and are not subject to this document. Do not propagate these tokens onto those pages, and do not import their tokens here. When a second surface adopts this world, extend this file; until then, its scope is one page.

The page reads as a Bauhaus foundation-course worktable: a warm grey working surface with a visible ruled baseline, ink-black text, and three primary colors that are not a palette but a set of assigned jobs. A red circle means action and active state. A blue square means structure. A yellow triangle means warning. Nothing on the page is colored for mood; every mark is either a form doing a job or ink. Surfaces are white planes laid onto the table with a hairline rule, never cards with radius and shadow. Type is a single alphabet, lowercase in headings, tightly tracked, with hierarchy carried by size and weight alone.

The thesis behind the look is that independence gets proven by admission, not by seals. So the page refuses both the green/gold "trustworthy finance" funnel — no trust badges, no gold, no soft reassuring gradients — and its brutalist opposite: nothing here is ugly for effect, everything is squared because it is measured. The one genuine self-critical device in the build is the visibly unbuilt testimonial slot: hatched, dashed, labelled as waiting. The system would rather show an empty jig than a fake finished part.
keyCharacteristics: Three primaries with fixed semantic roles; no fourth accent, no tint variants.
Zero corner radius everywhere except true circles.
One typeface (Jost), lowercase headings, no second family.
Flat by construction: hairline rules and inset strokes instead of shadows.
A visible 32px baseline grid drawn on the page background.
Geometric marks (::before square / circle / triangle) instead of icons.

rules.name: The Assigned Role Rule
rules.body: Red is action and active state. Blue is structure. Yellow is warning. A color never takes another's job, and no element gets a primary color for emphasis alone. If a new element cannot be classified as action, structure, or warning, it is ink.

rules.name: The One Pressable Red Rule
rules.body: Red on a surface either is the thing you press or is the thing you just chose. The hero disc is the single sanctioned non-interactive use, because it is the circle carrying the person who acts.

rules.name: The Ink-Or-Primary Rule
rules.body: There are no tints, no 60%-opacity accents, no hover washes. State changes swap a whole token (red → red-deep, rule → ink, rule → red), never a transparency.

rules.name: The Single Alphabet Rule
rules.body: One family, full stop. Hierarchy comes from size, weight (400/500/600/700) and case, not from a paired face. Automated checks flag this build as single-font; that finding is an accepted, documented exception, not a defect. Single-alphabet typography is native to the Bauhaus foundation world and the measured ramp already separates every role. Do not "fix" it by adding a serif or a mono.

rules.name: The Lowercase Heading Rule
rules.body: H1 and H2 are lowercase, always. Anything that is a sentence addressed to the reader — step headings, the person's name — opts back into sentence case explicitly. Nothing is ALL CAPS above 0.8rem.

rules.name: The Module Rule
rules.body: Every spatial value is calc(var(--u) * n). A raw px margin is a bug.

rules.name: The Rebalance-Not-Shrink Rule
rules.body: On wider viewports the composition redistributes weight (grid split, disc grows, CTA caps). Nothing simply scales up.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If an element needs to read as distinct, give it a plane, a rule, or a fill — never a drop shadow, and never a radius.

rules.name: The Form-Marker Rule
rules.body: Every component-level indicator is one of the three primary forms, sized 10–15px, drawn in CSS as a ::before or a .form-* element. No icon fonts, no SVG pictograms, no emoji glyphs in the component layer.

rules.name: The Square-Becomes-Circle Rule
rules.body: Selection is expressed by a blue square turning into a red circle. That transformation is the system's core interaction signature; do not replace it with a checkmark, a fill-only change, or a color-only change.

dos: Do classify every new element as action (red circle), structure (blue square), or warning (yellow triangle) before choosing its color. If it fits none, it is ink.
Do build every spatial value as calc(var(--u) * n) on the 8px module, and keep the 32px baseline grid visible on the page ground.
Do keep radius at 0 on everything that is not literally a circle.
Do lay content on white planes with a 1px rule border and no shadow.
Do draw indicators as CSS geometry (.form-sq / .form-ci / .form-tr and their ::before equivalents) at 10–15px.
Do keep headings lowercase at 500 weight with −0.02em tracking, and let sentence-level headings opt out with text-transform:none.
Do give every interactive element the same focus treatment: 3px Structure Blue outline at 2px offset.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more; the shipped floors are 64 (CTA), 62 (option), 56 (input, sticky), 52 (chip).
Do mark content that is genuinely missing as visibly unbuilt (hatch, dash, "waiting" label) rather than filling it with plausible placeholder copy.
Do use one typeface. The single-font finding on this build is an accepted exception, recorded here so it is not re-opened.
donts: Don't swap the color roles — no blue buttons, no red section labels, no yellow text.
Don't introduce a fourth accent, a tint scale, or an opacity-based hover wash. State changes swap whole tokens.
Don't add corner radius, drop shadows, or hover lift to planes. Inset strokes are the only permitted box-shadow.

Don't use gradients as decorative surface fills. Gradients are permitted only as drafting operations — the baseline rule, the portrait mask, the hatch — because that is how this build already uses them.
Don't add icon libraries, icon fonts, or SVG pictograms. Typographic arrows (→) and the three primary forms are the entire mark vocabulary.
Don't set ALL CAPS above 0.8rem, or add a second typeface to create hierarchy.
Don't apply these tokens to index.html, admin.html, blog.html or gdpr.html; those surfaces are a different, older identity and this system does not govern them yet.
Don't lower a contrast value to make a design read better. The shipped floors are 4.98:1 on the primary action, 4.93:1 on placeholders, and ≥7.25:1 on all other text.
